claim: wrangler >=4.113.0 changed what `wrangler dev` does. wrangler dev started in a headless AI agent environment now prints the Local Explorer API URL and basic resource routes. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
label: differential

claim: wrangler >=4.116.0 changed what `wrangler check startup` does. wrangler check startup no longer prints an alpha warning. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
label: differential

claim: wrangler >=4.121.0 changed what `wrangler preview` does. wrangler preview now prints a concise success summary instead of the previous box-art settings summary. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
label: source

claim: wrangler >=4.113.0 changed what `deploy` does. The deploy output now reads The following bindings need to be provisioned: and drops the Experimental: prefix from the resource provisioning header. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
label: differential

claim: wrangler >=4.116.0 changed what `deploy` does. Wrangler deploy automatically registers the project-derived workers.dev account subdomain on a first deploy when running in a detected agent environment. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
label: differential

claim: wrangler >=4.126.0 changed what `.cloudflare/output/v0/config.json` does. The mode a build was produced in is now written to .cloudflare/output/v0/config.json as a mode field, alongside the account and compliance settings. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
label: differential

claim: wrangler >=4.129.1 changed what `bundle size reporter` does. The bundle size reporter now compares the uncompressed bundle size against the 64 MiB limit for its color-coded warnings, instead of gzip size against 3 MiB. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
label: differential

claim: wrangler >=4.131.1 changed what `deployed trigger output` does. Wrangler now prefixes explicit custom domain production states with production: in deployed trigger output, so the labels match Preview labels. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
label: differential

claim: wrangler >=4.136.0 changed what `wrangler preview --json` does. When a Worker is missing its Preview configuration, wrangler preview --json now returns a structured error and a suggested_config patch. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
label: differential

claim: wrangler >=4.148.0 changed what `--temporary` does. The terms notice, the proof-of-work message, and the claim details printed by --temporary now go to stderr instead of stdout. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
label: differential

claim: wrangler >=4.148.0 changed what `wrangler types` does. wrangler types now declares the built-in Text module patterns even when they are not repeated in the Wrangler configuration. Silent: code written for older versions still runs, without an error.
label: differential
